findings.name: Page title
findings.evidence: SYNTHETIC; no network request made. head title count: 2; "Hi" (2 characters). 30–60 characters is a display heuristic, not a Google requirement.
findings.impact: A descriptive unique title helps readers and search tools identify the page.
findings.fix: Remove duplicate <title> elements; retain one unique descriptive title.

findings.name: AI extraction readability
findings.evidence: SYNTHETIC; no network request made. TinyFish Fetch returned 163 characters (excerpt complete). The 100-character warning threshold is a heuristic, not an understanding/SEO guarantee. "Hi": present in Fetch text. Excerpt: A practical guide to accessible garden design. Plan an accessible garden with useful paths and planting ideas for all visitors. This is synthetic fixture extraction text.
findings.impact: Text available to Fetch can be consumed by extraction tools; semantic understanding and visibility are not proven.
findings.fix: Keep primary content as accessible text. Compare the excerpt to the intended summary; ensure important headings/content are included without login or canvas-only rendering.
findings.source: Synthetic fixture contract — TinyFish Fetch markdown, ttl=0

findings.name: Search visibility observation
findings.evidence: SYNTHETIC; no network request made. TinyFish Search query "accessible garden design", US/en, first response page; 1 results returned; exact page matches 1. [{"url":"https://example.com/flawed","title":"A practical guide to accessible garden design","snippet":"Synthetic test snippet; TinyFish was not called."}]. No Google rank/index status inferred from presence or absence.
findings.impact: Query results and snippets show how this provider describes content at this moment; they cannot establish overall search visibility or causation.
findings.fix: Compare returned snippets with your intended title/summary. If this page is absent, try a relevant target query and review readability/content; absence in one query is not evidence of deindexing.
findings.source: Synthetic fixture contract — TinyFish Search response (not a Google measurement)

findings.name: Same-origin link health
findings.evidence: SYNTHETIC; no network request made. Optional link checks disabled; zero links requested.
findings.impact: Broken destination links can hurt navigation.
findings.fix: If needed, run a separately authorized bounded check of up to ten same-origin links.

score.formula: round(100 × Σ(weight × value) / Σ(measured weight)); pass=1, warning=0.5, fail=0. Not tested and weight=0 observations excluded. Coverage = measured scored checks / all scored checks. This is a page hygiene heuristic, not a Google or ranking score.

limits: Single page and bounded rendered snapshot only; length thresholds and scoring are heuristics.
No Google rankings, indexing status, traffic, backlinks, Lighthouse scores or Core Web Vitals measured.
Search presence/absence is one provider query observation, excluded from scoring; no causal ranking claim.
JSON-LD syntax/presence only, not schema.org validation, factual accuracy or rich-result eligibility.
Remote TinyFish Fetch independently resolves/follows redirects; DNS/redirect safety there is a provider trust boundary. Local requests are pinned; Browser routes validate but cannot pin remote DNS.
Browser GET-only filtering, request cap and settling deadline can limit rendering; inaccessible DOM checks stay not tested.
No optional link requests, authentication, interactive actions, writes or audited-site modifications.
